sanskrit:
येऽप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः ।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् ॥ ९-२३॥
iast:
ye’pyanyadevatā bhaktā yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ
te’pi māmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipūrvakam 9-23
translation: Even those devotees, who, endowed with faith worship other gods, worship Me alone, O son of Kunti, (but) by the wrong method.
